scope: Heroes IV creature ability identities, shared-PK AbilityHOMM4 details, and CreatureAbility links for all 74 catalogued creatures.
policy: No shared catalog, SQL schema, contract, database or GitHub files are modified by this overlay. Only additions are merge candidates; AbilityHOMM4.Mechanics remains NULL because the current data contract reserves non-null mechanics JSON.

row.Name: Three heads
row.Description: Attacks three adjacent enemy targets at once.

row.Name: Aging
row.Description: An attack can reduce the target attack and defense and halve its movement.

row.Name: Area attack
row.Description: An attack affects a small area around the impact point.

row.Name: Siege penetration
row.Description: Ignores obstacle and castle-wall penalties when firing.

row.Name: Berserk
row.Description: The creature cannot be controlled and is immune to fear and terror.

row.Name: Bind
row.Description: Immobilizes the attacked target and reduces its attack by 50% until the attacker moves.

row.Name: Blind
row.Description: An attack can cast Blind on the target, disabling it for three turns.

row.Name: Block
row.Description: Has a 30% chance to block an attack completely.

row.Name: Bloodlust
row.Description: Can cast Bloodlust.

row.Name: Spellcasting
row.Description: Can cast the listed combat spells.

row.Name: Siege engine
row.Description: Suffers no firing penalty through obstacles or castle walls.

row.Name: Charge
row.Description: Damage increases by 3.5% for each square traversed before attacking.

row.Name: Curse
row.Description: Can cast Curse on an attacked target.

row.Name: Devour
row.Description: Can instantly kill a number of enemy creatures.

row.Name: Double attack
row.Description: Makes a second attack after the enemy retaliates.

row.Name: Double shot
row.Description: Fires twice per attack; the second shot follows the enemy retaliation.

row.Name: Elemental
row.Description: Immune to mind, healing and resurrection effects; cannot be resurrected.

row.Name: Fire attack
row.Description: Fire attacks deal 50% less damage to creatures resistant to fire.

row.Name: Fire breath
row.Description: Damages the unit directly behind the primary target.

row.Name: Fire resistance
row.Description: Immune to fire spells and takes 50% less damage from fire attacks.

row.Name: Fire shield
row.Description: Reflects 25% of melee damage back at the attacker.

row.Name: First strike
row.Description: Attacks before the target can retaliate.

row.Name: Flying
row.Description: Can fly over obstacles, creatures and castle walls and ignores difficult-terrain penalties.

row.Name: Freezing attack
row.Description: Can paralyze a target for two turns; the target cannot move, attack or retaliate.

row.Name: Giant slayer
row.Description: Deals 50% more damage to level-four creatures.

row.Name: Incendiary missiles
row.Description: Damages all units in a 9x9 area around the impact point.

row.Name: Hypnotize
row.Description: Can take control of an attacked enemy stack for one turn; mind-immune units resist it.

row.Name: Cold attack
row.Description: Cold attacks deal 50% less damage to creatures resistant to cold.

row.Name: Summon ice demon
row.Description: Can spend mana to summon an ice-demon stack that disappears after combat.

row.Name: Cold resistance
row.Description: Immune to cold spells and takes 50% less damage from cold attacks.

row.Name: Magic immunity
row.Description: Immune to offensive and supportive magic and magic-based effects.

row.Name: Incorporeal
row.Description: Defense is increased by 100%.

row.Name: Lightning attack
row.Description: An attack also casts Lightning; damage is 30 per creature.

row.Name: Long range
row.Description: Reduces long-range firing penalties, except through fortifications.

row.Name: Long weapon
row.Description: Can attack from a slightly greater melee distance.

row.Name: Luck
row.Description: Can cast Fortune.

row.Name: Magic mirror
row.Description: Can reflect an incoming spell; offensive spells return at 50% strength.

row.Name: Mana drain
row.Description: Can steal two spell points from an enemy mage and transfer them to an allied mage.

row.Name: Mechanical
row.Description: Unaffected by morale and effects that work only on living creatures.

row.Name: Mirth
row.Description: Can cast Mirth.

row.Name: Multiple attack
row.Description: Attacks all adjacent enemy targets simultaneously.

row.Name: First-strike immunity
row.Description: Negates abilities and spells that grant an enemy first strike.

row.Name: Normal melee
row.Description: Suffers no melee penalty normally applied to ranged creatures.

row.Name: No retaliation
row.Description: Attacks without exposing itself to retaliation.

row.Name: Sea bonus
row.Description: On sea battles gains +2 speed and movement and +50% attack and defense.

row.Name: Poison
row.Description: Adds damage each turn until battle ends; poison is treated as a Death curse.

row.Name: Gaze immunity
row.Description: Immune to blinding and petrifying gaze attacks.

row.Name: Protection from Chaos
row.Description: Gains 50% defense and magic protection against Chaos creatures and spells.

row.Name: Protection from Death
row.Description: Gains 50% defense and magic protection against Death creatures and spells.

row.Name: Protection from Life
row.Description: Gains 50% defense and magic protection against Life creatures and spells.

row.Name: Random spellcasting
row.Description: On attack can cast one of the listed random offensive spells.

row.Name: Ranged attack
row.Description: Can attack at range but has a 50% melee-attack penalty.

row.Name: First ranged strike
row.Description: Can fire before the target can retaliate.

row.Name: Rebirth
row.Description: Can spend mana to resurrect creatures; if the stack dies first, it may trigger automatically.

row.Name: Regeneration
row.Description: Restores 50 hit points at the beginning of each turn.

row.Name: Magic resistance
row.Description: Has a 50% chance to resist most hostile spells and takes reduced spell damage.

row.Name: Resurrection
row.Description: Can spend mana to resurrect fallen friendly creatures.

row.Name: Fear
row.Description: Forces living attacked units to retreat two squares and prevents retaliation if they remain away.

row.Name: Short range
row.Description: Deals substantially less damage when firing from far away.

row.Name: Skeleton
row.Description: Ranged defense is increased by 100%.

row.Name: Stealth
row.Description: Remains hidden on the adventure map from low-level creatures and heroes without sufficient Scouting.

row.Name: Stone gaze
row.Description: Can petrify and instantly kill a number of enemy creatures.

row.Name: Stone skin
row.Description: Defense is increased by 25%; the same spell adds no further effect.

row.Name: Strength
row.Description: The source labels this ability but provides no mechanical description.

row.Name: Strike and return
row.Description: Returns to its starting position after attacking.

row.Name: Stun
row.Description: An attack can paralyze the target for one turn; undead, elementals and constructs resist it.

row.Name: Tax collector
row.Description: Each creature in the stack yields one gold per day.

row.Name: Teleportation
row.Description: Can move instantly to any selected battlefield square.

row.Name: Terror
row.Description: Can spend mana to make the target lose its next two turns.

row.Name: Endurance
row.Description: The source labels this ability but provides no mechanical description.

row.Name: Undead
row.Description: Morale is zero; immune to mind effects, healing and resurrection.

row.Name: Unlimited retaliation
row.Description: Can retaliate every time it is attacked.

row.Name: Unlimited ammunition
row.Description: Never runs out of shots.

row.Name: Life drain
row.Description: Restores itself and revives creatures in the stack for 50% of damage dealt.

row.Name: Weakness
row.Description: Can cast Weakness on an attacked target.

row.Name: Wide breath
row.Description: An expanded breath attack covers a substantially larger cone.

supports: The manual states that every creature has at least one special ability and explains that creature information exposes descriptions and ability icons.
The manual distinguishes passive creature abilities, ranged/spell attacks and special abilities in combat.
Seven original-ruleset Heroes IV creature pages enumerate ability icons, names and mechanics for all 74 catalogued base/expansion creatures.
The pages separate the original-ruleset creature tables from Equilibris content.

gaps: Zombie Endurance and Behemoth Strength are named in the source tables but their descriptions are placeholders; they are represented as Other with unresolved trigger/mechanics rather than being called absent.
Some source rows describe local-language spell names or community notes about bugs; only explicit ability effects are summarized and no unsupported formula is inserted.
These pages are secondary original-ruleset cross-checks, not a developer data dump. No ability is inferred from artwork or ordinary movement.

verification.manualSupports: General creature-information and combat ability model only
